nom: cocokind Oil to Milk Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I love this cleansing balm! The squeeze tube packaging is a huge plus because it's much more hygienic than dipping my fingers into a tub, especially if I need to apply more product. It easily removes all of the sunscreen and makeup I wear. When I follow it with the Milky-Soft Cleanser, my oily skin feels clean without being overstripped. I've also used it to remove waterproof mascara, and it doesn't irritate my eyes at all. Overall, it's a definite win for me!
I've been using this for years and it remains one of my favorite facewashes ever. I especially love that it leaves my face feeling so hydrated, even before applying moisturizer.

I have dry, sensitive skin and love love love a hydrating, non-drying cleanser. This was not that, at least not for me. It left my skin with that same "squeaky clean" feeling a lot of old-school cleansers do. Might be better for combo skin, but this wasn't what I was looking for.
Took me a while to get used to this type of cleanser but now I love it. Cleans my skin well, I like that my skin doesn't react to it.

This does a great job at removing sunscreen, sweat, and makeup. I couldnt figure out, though, from the description whether this had to be followed by a water based cleanser. The name of it makes it sound like it could be a two-in-one and therefore not need another cleanser after. For me, it leaves an oily layer that I need to wash off with another face wash.

I first used this cleanser in the winter and was fine with it, but it was too heavy for the summer. Then I had a bad eczema flare on my face and I fell in love with this cleanser because it causes no irritation to my dry, cracked, easily irritated skin which hates most other products. In fact, it's soothing to wash with it twice a day. Another bonus is using it twice a day reduces the oily skin where I don't have eczema.

avis.titre: You may not like it at first, but you will!
avis.texte: I was used to a stripping, drying face wash, so this felt really weird at first. It won't give you the squeaky clean feeling I once enjoyed, but it leaves your skin very soft and moisturized. It has not caused me to break out. I will be repurchasing!

I have repurchased this cleanser probably 300 times. I do not wear makeup on the regular, so this is the perfect, gentle formula to remove my daily sunscreen and any "grime" that may have developed. I have very dry, sensitive skin and have had no issues with this product - I actually find it to be lightweight but hydrating. It does not strip my skin! Defintely will remain a staple in my routine as I don't even feel the need to explore other options out there.
Such a weird consistency when I first tried it, I was so thrown off! But I hung in there and I really do enjoy how this soothes my skin, but still makes me feel cleaner.

avis.titre: Go to for the last 6 years
avis.texte: This has been my go to cleanser for six years. I'm not a big makeup wearer, but when I do, this takes it ALL off. I love that it doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped. It's also nice to have the option for a more lightweight feel by adding water to turn it into a milky texture.
I have found my new favorite cleanser! I have incredibly dry skin and this is the only cleanser that doesn't strip my skin. I double cleanse every night and this is the perfect second cleanser!

This cleanser is the first item I bought from cocokind. I've always had fairly sensitive skin and have been prone to breakouts for 7 years. After using it for the last 3 - 4 months, my face looks and feels better which has also helped my mental health during postpartum days. Highly recommend this cleanser!
Love this product, it remove my sunscreen easily, and after I go in with a gentle face wash and my face feels super soft.

Intially this cleanser to some getting used it. once your face has been cleansed it feels as if it has oil or something on it still but in a good way-you face will feel ridiculously soft! The only thing I don't love is that I don't feel like it always gets all the make up off as well as the jelly cleanser. I still use interchangeably with Jelly cleanser.
this is my favorite cleanser to get my makeup off and I love that it doesnt make face feel stripped or dry like other brands cleansers Ive used

I like this cleanser - it's not my favorite product from cocokind but I would still use it! The only thing I don't like is how it doesn't get bubbly (I know thats the point) but my mind can't come to terms with it. I used it for a month and never had any issues with it! So overall - it's a good product but I just prefer the milky face and body cleanser.

Nothing's ever removed my makeup like this. I really love how the oil breaks my makeup down, including my mascara, and it feels really nice to emulsify and cleanse my skin when I add water. I like using it as the first part of my double cleanse, but it would honestly be fine as the only cleansing step!

for the past few months, i've been using a salicylic acid cleanser to help with my closed comedones, and it worked for the first few weeks. however, recently i noticed that it was actually making my skin worse, and realized i might be over exfoliating. i decided to go back to a simple but effective hydrating face wash, and picked this up. and it's fixed my skin so fast! this face wash cleans my skin but also hydrates it and i love how it leaves me feeling!
I love this cleanser. It is perfect for my 'normal' skin - doesn't leave me feeling either oily or dry. Using it straight out of the tube is my favorite!

This cleanser has been a favorite of mine for years! I love using it as a second cleanser after I remove my makeup. My skin feels so smooth and soft afterwords. I love that you can use it straight our in the tube for a more oily cleanser or make wet for a more foamy cleanse m!
Great cleanser! Very gently clean the skin without stripping and irritating
I like using this to remove my makeup because it feels cleansing and gets in deep while still being gentle!
genuinely felt a difference in my skin after using this cleanser - so soft and clean, about to buy my second bottle now:)

avis.titre: Skip if you're looking for chemical exfoliation
avis.texte: As an esthetician, this is good if you're dry and need something to replace a good oil cleanser without stripping the skin. But at the same time, if you're looking for something that also exfoliates: skip it. It cleans the skin, but doesn't really exfoliate it. So if you're over 30 skip this. You'll want something with a bha, azelic acid, mandelic acid, or others. This is an okay cleanser and good barrier repair option though! My skin was not want for moisture with this cleanser. It simply wasn't what I was needing.
My favorite all time cleanser. Remove make up. Makes my pore feel squeaky clean.
I really like this stuff. i do wish it was creamier, but it leaves my skin soft and refreshed.

I LOVE this cleanser. I'm a 57 yo woman with normal skin. I apply it to dry skin at night and massage it in. It removes all makeup and sunscreen really well and I love the feel of it and the smell! I've tried other similar products and always return to cocokind. Just wish they sold a larger tube.

avis.titre: This is the worst oil cleanser I've tried.
avis.texte: It does NOT turn to milk, and is weirdly sticky and doesn't wash off. I have to use another cleanser to get this off of my face. It's not a good product, unfortunately.

Way too thick! This does NOT take off your makeup but in fact it smears it all over your face. It also turns into the lotion portion too fast. I love a lot of cocokind products but this one needs a redo. I am finding myself having to wash my face with something else after.

This is one of the best milk cleansers I've used. I live in Colorado so I need as much moisture as I can get. This cleanser is so gentle and hydrating, my face immediately feels dry and flaky the next morning if I use another cleanser at night.
Does not emulsify well at all but does an okay job taking off makeup. Could definitely find better options. Plus its pretty smal packaging.
It makes my skin soft instead of making it dry! Loved this product!
I will say I like how this cleanser felt going on my face. But I absolutely cannot stand strong smells. I can't describe it It's almost like a lavender? It is strong smelling made me nauseous.

The only cleanser you need on your counter! Taking this cleanser with clean dry hands and using it as a oil cleanser aka "first cleanse", then rising and going in again with this cleanser and a bit of water creates the most milky and sudsy wash for my "second cleanse". On the days I am not wearing make-up I can trust to go in with cleanser and a bit of water to get the job done.

I like this as a take my make up off cleanser before i use an acne based cleanser. I cant just use this as my only cleanser though as it is really gentle but if thats what you need then itll be great for you

avis.titre: Great to Remove Makeup on Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: As someone who loves to wear makeup but tends to be hormonal acne prone and deals with eczema, I need something gentle to remove my makeup while not stripping my skin's natural barrier. This cleanser has done wonders for removing my makeup and sunscreen from the day while also ensuring that I have a strong, healthy skin barrier. It is not drying, and it does not sting my eyes, unlike many other cleansing balms I have tried.
I never write reviews honestly but this cleanser has changed my skin! If you have sensitive eczema prone skin this is an awesome product to try. Love it!
This might be an amazing cleanser. Unfortunately, it has such a strong medicinal/floral smell that I can't stand to use it. Honestly terrible.

avis.titre: my fave!! (used for the past 6 months)
avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser since June of this year and it has absolutely done wonders for my skin (typically combination - dry/oily skin leaning more towards dry). I've experienced far less breakouts with the exception of "that time of the month" which is inevitable, and have also never received more compliments on my skin condition from friends and family who have seen it evolve over the past six months. LOVE this product, and always keep a backup bottle on deck.
My favorite face wash, especially in the winter when my skin is extra dry!

I cannot stress how much this cleanser is amazing. I started using Cocokind at 19. Before I started, my skin was coming off my face in patches with even the lightest pressure. I have no clue what the problem was, but this cleanser saved my skin. It's gentle and helped to cleanse my face without stripping my face beyond the excess moisture. I have naturally oily skin but also sensitive skin, so the extra is removed, but I never have the dry or stretched feeling that other cleansers have given me. Currently, I'm 22 and am not changing from this any time soon. 10/10, no notes.
This will forever be a staple in my routine. It is so creamy and removes all of my makeup. It leaves my skin so soft and clean!!

I use this as makeup remover and to double cleanse after a long day, it works great! It removes makeup so well and my face feels hydrated after. I usually follow it up with a regular cleanser bc it does feel a lil oily to me even after washing. Btw i have dry skin
I have super sensitive and dry skin. This has been my go to cleanser since 2022! I love how clean and fresh my skin feels while not getting dried out!
A staple item for me - everyday use! My skin Feels so clean after using and feels like it really get into the skin / pores - esp my nose and chin

Everything about this balm is exactly what I wanted. I use it at the end of the day to help remove makeup and excess oil. I have sensitive skin and so this product being scentless is a dream! A small annoyance is that it sometimes gets into my eyes and will cause blurry vision for a short bit but ultimately I love the product.
This oil to milk cleaner really helps remove all my makeup and leave my skin feeling soft.

This has now become one of my favorite cocokind products! I was late to the game in trying it, but I have noticed great results already! I use this as part of my evening double cleanse, followed by a water-based cleanser. It is great to remove oils from the day, sunscreen, makeup, etc. It has noticeably cleared up my skin and leaves it feeling so soft and smooth! I want to keep a constant supply of this on hand! Love it!
My favorite cleanser. I've been using it for about 3-4 years!
My favorite cleanser, doesn't leave me dry but also makes my face clean!
This has been my go-to cleanser for years! It always leaves my skin feeling fresh and plump.
it's a nice cleanser that does the oil to milk transition well. it is good that it's gentle and not stripping, but it also does leave my face leaving a little oily and not completely clean.
Ive been using this cleanser for 5 years and Im obsessed with it. Ill never use another product!
This had fragrance in it which caused a reaction. I reviewed the ingredients before purchasing so I was disappointed. Please in the future informed customers that there is fragrance.

The oil is more solidified, like coconut oil, not like a typical oil to milk cleanser. Because it's solidified, it takes more time to work into the skin, which is not a problem, but when washing it off, my skin doesn't feel clean at all. I feel like there's still a heavy residue left on my skin so I have go back with another cleanser to wash it off. Not a good product for me.

Having acne and black heads in the past, I was always hesitant to do a moisturizing first cleanser since I was always trying to dry out my skin. I love this cleanser. It doesn't clog my skin, making it feel soft instead. I love it!
This is a very gentle face cleanser. I love the way it feels and my skin has improved since I started using this product along with moisturizer and the turmeric tonic.

Last year, in my search for skincare low in toxins, I discovered Cocokind. This was the first product I tried. At first, I was confused about how to use it, but once I figured it out, I really started to like it. The first thing I noticed is that after about a month of using it, the recurring breakouts on my chin went away. Amazing! I love how gentle this product is and I also love its affordability. The one con I have experienced is that it is not super effective at targeting/getting rid of my clogged pores. However, I still love this as an everyday cleanser and alternate it with the AHA cleanser to make sure my clogged pores are being addressed. Thank you for an awesome product!

avis.titre: Great for oily skin and double-cleansing
avis.texte: i have oily acne prone skin and finding out that i needed an oil-based cleanser to remove the oil was a game changer (thank you to the cocokind email newsletter for that bit of knowledge!). once i started the double cleansing method, my skin had improved so much! the oil to milk cleanser is step 1 and a water based cleanser (like the aha jelly cleanser, or a salicylic acid cleaner) is step 2. reading the cocokind blogs and email newsletter has educated me so much, so i definitely recommend that too! #cocokindbrandtrip
feels amazing on my skin and has really cleared it up and it looks so smooth!

avis.titre: Best face wash. Never trying something else.
avis.texte: I ve been using this as my face wash for years. Doubles as a makeup remover. Keeps my dry skin hydrated and feeling moisturized. Recommend it to all my dry skin peeps

This cleanser started my love for Cocokind! It really seems so simple, but I love that it contains clean ingredients, and not that many of them. I love massaging my face, and using the slip of the cleanser to do gua sha or mostly use my fingertips in upward circular motions. It really does work out trapped dirt and blackheads in my pores. It leaves my skin plump and bouncy, and doesn t irritate my eyes. It is the one product I can never be without, and I always stock up on the regular and travel sizes so I can take it with me wherever I go!

I use this to melt my makeup way and I absolutely love it! I put it on totally dry (dry hands, dry face) and it works just as well as any other cleansing balm. It works so well and completely gets rid of my eye makeup. I love that my skin doesn't feel stripped while still getting squeaky clean.
my favorite gentle cleanser! takes off makeup easily and leaves my skin feeling so nice
this really gets all my makeup off, including my eye makeup! and i love that it's a thicker formula so i can pack it for travel too!

I have oily acne prone skin and finding out that I needed an oil-based cleanser to remove the oil was a game changer (thank you to the Cocokind email newsletter for that bit of knowledge!). Once I started the double cleansing method, my skin had improved so much! The oil to milk cleanser is step 1 and a water based cleanser (like the AHA jelly cleanser, or a salicylic acid cleaner) is step 2. Reading the cocokind blogs and email newsletter has educated me so much, so I definitely recommend that too! #cocokindbrandtrip

This is an amazing face wash to melt off makeup but also cleanse your face. I usually massage it into my face for a few minutes (especially when I have make up on ) and then start incorporating walk to get the milky consistency on my face. Overall, love this!

I have oily skin and sometimes I feel like my skin isnt getting all the way clean with the products I use until I came upon this one. I love the formula its not super heavy and it doesnt strip my skin it leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated.

This oil to milk cleanser is a dream. I have ordered it not only for myself, but for my children as well. It melts away makeup and grime effortlessly, then rinses off clean without stripping my skin. The texture is silky, the scent is calming, and it leaves my skin soft, hydrated, and glowing. A little daily luxury I truly love!
This is a holy grail type product! I use it dry to work out any black heads or sebaceous filaments! It has worked wonders on my skin

this is my favorite cleanser. the only one that i think actually really forreal removes makeup? i cannot be bothered with another makeup remover so i love that this does the job and leaves my skin feeling so so so soft!
Oil of milk cleanser feel great, after washing my face I dont feel like its dried out or greasy..

Ive probably bought this cleanser five times over the last couple of years. Its my go-to when I travel because it doubles as both a face wash and makeup remover, and it also doesnt leak or melt in my bag. Its super gentle on my extremely sensitive skin and has never caused any irritation or flare-ups. The only reason I gave it 4 out of 5 stars instead of a full 5 is that it occasionally leaves a slight film in my eyes after I use it.

I loveeee trying out non toxic products but like many have commented, this leaves a weird film on your skin. In an attempt to not waste it i would only use it after my other cleansers. Doesnt even remotely take makeup off. I hate how its runny, and the smell was not great. I ended up throwing it away because i couldnt stand using it.
This is my most purchased product. I use it everyday. My face doesn't feel dry after use. I love that this can be used to remove makeup as well.

Not for the eye area. Unfortunately, I didn't like this oil cleanser. It's very hard to emulsify and not matter how much water I add and massage, I end up needed to double cleanse. I can't use this around the eye area because it leaves a film on my eyes no matter how careful I am when using it. It's just fine if you don't use it around your eyes. But I's rather use another product that can be used around the eyes without irritation.

avis.titre: Essential step in a double cleanse.
avis.texte: Im a long time user of this oil to milk cleanser and I highly recommend it. I tried other cleansing oils and they have a fragrance or are messy. Ive tried balms and I dont like scooping them out and not being able to control the amount of product. This being in a tube is easy to control the amount and its not messy. I use this in my first step of a double cleanse almost nightly.
Bought because of the great reviews but was so dissapointed. Imagine washing your face with vaseline, thats ehat this feels like. Leaves a film over ur skin and doesnt feel clean afterwards

My face is EXTREMELY sensitive and this stuff is amazing on it. I love the way it feels on my face. It leaves my face feeling soft and hydrated. I swear it leaves you glowing as well. If you're thinking about buying, get it! It's a must have in my routine.

I tried this because i try to keep my products toxic free, but the smell is terrible, it feels like im washing my face with vasoline, and i dont like how it made my skin feel. I may be an outlier since it has many good reviews, but it wasnt for me.
My face is normally red and irritated after cleansing, but not with the oil to milk cleanser! My skin feels so soft and hydrated before I've even moisturized. CocoKind is my new go-to skincare brand!

avis.titre: I have used Oil to Milk Cleanser for years!
avis.texte: I have been using Oil to Milk Cleanser for a very long time and love the way it cleanses and makes my skin feel moisturized- never stripped. My husband now loves it, too!
I really like the way this cleans my face and takes off my makeup. Doesn't leave my skin feeling dry at all!

my skin feels amazing after using this cleanser, but only if i'm washing my bare face. this cleanser does not budge my makeup, let alone wash it away. it's gentle on the skin, which is great, but it's way too gentle on makeup, which makes me question just how clean my skin is after using this even on a bare face.

My skin was severely irritated from other cleansers and using acne products since my skin is acne prone. I was originally worried about using this product. Oil with acne? But it works GREAT. My skin feels soft and smooth, pores look finer, and I have a nice glow. Acne concerns are essentially gone. It also dissolves any makeup I might have on, which is great.

avis.titre: great for the desert and dry skin
avis.texte: This is the only cleanser that works well with my dry skin in the Las Vegas desert! I've tried a few others since my first time grabbing this and had to come back as it is the only cleanser that doesn't dry my skin out in this dry climate!

I've been using this face wash for a couple of years now, and I LOVE what it does for my skin! The scent has changed over time from a rose smell to more fruity, but this tube in particular has a bad smell. It doesn't smell expired to me, but it's almost like a mild camphor smell. I've gotten used to it, but it was better before.

I originally planned to use this cleanser as a makeup remover, but found it left a film that sealed in the makeup residue and made it even harder to remove after. It doesnt cleanse my skin at all, just leaves behind a layer of oil that doesn't rinse off.

I use this product in the morning and/or for double cleanses at night occasionally. It is such a gentle cleaner. I have decently oily skin and this cleans it so well, and helps prevent breakouts. My favorite cleanser overall.
Took off MAYBE 60% of my makeup and left a nasty film on my face after rinsing.

I'm buying like 4 more! When I say this melts away my makeup and the day it melts away. This thick consistency is so emollient and removes all makeup in a single application. When I add water I totally turn into a milk face. The creamy milk like formula is hydrating while also strips the makeup away leaving my clear clean dry skin.

I absolutely love this product! I love to use it at the end of the day, especially if I have on make up. I feel like it gets all my make up and the grime from the day off. If I feel especially grungy I double cleanse with their other cleanser the AHA jelly cleanser. This product keeps my skin feeling hydrated and definitely never feels dry after cleansing. Game changer!

I don't normally leave reviews, but this is SO bad. I got a travel size with some other Cocokind products (which were all great), and I don't think I've ever encountered a worse skincare product. It just sits on the face and takes nothing off. I think someone thought the milk to oil concept was ingenious, when - in reality - it just creates a gross mess. I felt disgusting after using this. I asked my husband to try it, and he was equally put off by the texture and performance. This is a horrible product and makes me question if I want to keep ordering any Cocokind products. Blech!!!!! Turned me off from the brand!
So soft and gentle on my skin! The only disadvantage to this cleanser is that it does not work very hard on my acne personally!

this has amazing reviews so i was excited to try. the directions say to wet your hands, put the product in and then massage onto dry face. it mixes onto your face up just like typical makeup removing balm feels (although this is runny like a cleanser). the bad part about this is, when you try to wash it off, it leaves a thick film on your face that no amount of water rinsing removes, it is so bizarre. i have to wash it with a separate cleanser to get it off. at first i thought this was a weird reaction with my makeup, so another day i tried using it on a bare face, the end result feels exactly the same. its also kind of pricey for a small bottle. do not recommend at all.

This cleanser is a life saver year round but especially in the winter. It gets all my makeup off well and doesn't strip my skin dry. I also like the consistency for a nice face massage at the end of the day.

I'm not sure I like this product. I've followed your instructions and watched the video. It feels slippery on my face and I find that it does nothing when I add water. Not milky or foamy and rinsing does not remove the film it leaves. I'm not sure it is really cleansing my skin.
the only cleanser i've used for years... my skin feels clean without compromising any moisture. so gentle and effective.
It took a little time to get used to the consistency but this is now my favorite cleaner ever. My combo skin is very happy!

This is one of my favorite cocokind products :) I love how rubbing it on, it feels more like an oil, and very effectively removes my makeup. Once I add water it foams up and washes off beautifully. My skin is left feeling clean and moisturized. And I really love the smell of this wash

My #1 most used cocokind product, this incredible cleanser. What can I say? It is my absolute favorite product. I love when I do wear make up how easily it comes off, I love the oiliness it goes on & the milkiness when it comes off, I love how simple the product is & can be used & benefit my skin in so many ways! I got my mom to use this to remove her make up & she loved it! I feel like I'm getting a spa treatment after double cleansing with it. Absolutely adore!
My favorite product! Gentle on skin, helps get makeup off. I always look forward to this step of my skin routine.

FAVORITE CLEANSER OF ALL TIME. I have dry, sensitive skin and this cleanser is both gentle AND effective! I love that it's an oil cleanser that can be rinsed off like a traditional face wash. It's the best of both worlds. Super effective at removing makeup too. I never let a single drop of this product go to waste. Creamy, oil-to-milk gold.

Love how little you need for this to be effective. It is light, easy to apply, no scent and perfect for sensitive skin. I sometimes struggle for it to lather but overall it has been a game changer for my skin!
Really have enjoyed using this cleanser! Different from what I've used before and I was skeptical. It's been so great to use and easy!

I couldn't imagine a cleanser ever being so hydrating and exciting to use! The way this product melts into my skin and leaves it feeling nourished is truly unique. It's been a go to of mine for years and it pairs so well with the rest of my skincare routine.

i LOVE this cleanser. i've been using it for 4 years at least, and have been obsessed since day 1. i have sensitive skin too, and it's so nice and gentle, and my skin always feels refreshed after i wash it. i've even had friends who have stayed over use it and they were super impressed! always in my bathroom, my favorite cleanser. 10/10 recommend

Literally a GAME. CHANGER. I love the OTM for my dry skin. It always leaves my skin feeling super clean and never tight or itchy. It's also incredible for getting make up off gently. I promise you, this will become a staple in your routine... fair warning. ;)

I've tried others but none can compare! With sensitive skin with rosacea this is the only face wash I use. It leaves the skin feeling clean yet moisturized and soft. I do still use a water proof make up remover for the eyes but the oil to milk cleaners removes other makeup without leaving a trace.
This is the only face wash I use! Takes all my make-up off and leaves me feeling so refreshed!
This is one of my favorite cleansers ever. Reminds me of another brand that's 3x the cost. I love a cleanser that removes makeup and leaves my skin so soft. Definitely add this to your routine!
My go-to daily cleanser. I love how this leaves my skin feeling- soft and clean. When I wear makeup, it melts the makeup away so easily.

The holy grail of skin cleansers! At first, I didn't believe that this was washing the gunk off my face... but, my skin has never been happier since using it [I moved from a straight oil cleanser to this product about 4 years ago]. It's light, gentle, and is a nice soothing textural experience. Highly recommend.
I love this face wash and will always re-buy it! It's my go to makeup remover and perfect for a double cleanse. The texture is very soothing.

I love this facewash. I started using it consistently a year and half ago, and its so great. It's very gentle on my easily irritated skin. It takes my makeup off in 1-2 washes. If I have visibly dry skin and I use this face wash, it gently removes a lot of. I think that's my favorite thing about the face wash. It makes my skin look cleaner and healthier.

Did the formula change for this cleanser? I have been using the oil to milk cleanser consistently since 2018 or 2019 and have always loved it. Recently, I purchased one from Shoppers Drug Mart in Canada and it has a strong smell that I've not experienced before with this product. Also feels a bit different going on the skin...not bad, maybe a bit tingly? Overall, as a long time user, I'm disappointed as I loved this product but this smell is turning me off...
